[element-contrib-id]
=== `<contrib-id>` Contributor Identifier

One identifier for a person such as a contributor. This element will hold an ORCID, a trusted publisher’s identifier, a JST (Japan Science and Technology Agency) identifier, or an NII (National Individual Identifier).

#### Related Elements

`<contrib-id>` holds an external identifier, assigned to a contributor by an agency such as the publisher, an archive, an aggregator or hosting service, or an ORCID authority. The contents of this element should not be confused with the <<attribute-id,`@id`>> attribute, which holds an _internal_ document identifier that can be used by software to construct a simple link.

* <<attribute-assigning-authority,`@assigning-authority`>>
